Adds a Site to the warehouse map. The site code becomes the first segment of every LocationCode inside the facility, so it must be uppercase alphanumeric and unique across the service. Site code uniqueness is enforced here in the application layer rather than in the aggregate: a single aggregate cannot see its siblings. A newly registered Site is Active, and publishes SiteRegistered.

`siteRole` (ADR-0037) is optional: omitted means `UNSPECIFIED`. An unknown role is 422 `invalid-site-role`. The role never sets the transfer capability (ADR-0035 stays the only writer; see `GET /site-roles/transfer-defaults` for the per-role defaults).
